text.en:
The privileges granted by Commonwealth Act Numbered Two hundred and six to persons
retired under the provisions of Act Numbered Four thousand and fifty-one of the Philippine Legislature, and
reappointed to any position in the Government, are extended to persons retired under the provisions of Act
Numbered Twenty-five hundred and eighty-nine of the Philippine Legislature, who are reappointed to any
Government position.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, .December 17, 1937.
